name: spec-writer-tiny
about: T2 — a tiny change must not get a spec
prompt: /spec-writer change the app title to "Daily Habits"

graders.label: says no spec is needed
graders.rubric: PASS if the reply says this change is too small to need a spec (or that no spec is needed). FAIL if it wrote a spec, started an interview, or offered to write a spec anyway.
